capabilities: browse skills, commands, and agents from 17 tools in one place
search skills by name or file content with deep search
create new skills with a stepped wizard
edit skills inline with markdown preview
install skills from the skills.sh marketplace and export Claude Code conversations
extras: Desktop-only (macOS, Windows, Linux) because it reads and writes skill files outside the vault; the README discloses direct filesystem access as a risk capability. MIT licensed, free and open source, no telemetry. Full docs live at agentfiles.crafter.run/docs rather than in the README.
problem: Skill, command, rule, and agent files for coding agents are scattered across tool-specific directories outside the vault, with no unified way to browse, search, or edit them.

relations.evidence: Agentfiles imports Skillkit's portable API and reads a versioned snapshot

summary: AI skills manager that browses, creates, edits, and installs agent skills, commands, and agents across Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Windsurf, and more.
